targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "asset_risk" and r.equipment == "CircuitoAguaVaporCondensado" and r._field == "risk_score") |> last()
from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and r.kpi == "agua_por_mwh" and r._field == "value") |> last()
from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and r.kpi == "vapor_por_mwh" and r._field == "value") |> last()
from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and r.kpi == "condensado_recuperado" and r._field == "value") |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and (r.tag == "FT_5101-1" or r.tag == "FT_3001") and r.variable == "Flujo" and r._field == "value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and (r.kpi == "agua_por_mwh" or r.kpi == "vapor_por_mwh" or r.kpi == "condensado_recuperado") and r._field == "value")
from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpi" and r.kpi == "costo_agua_vapor_condensado" and r._field == "value") |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and (r.tag == "FT_5101-1" or r.tag == "FT_3001" or r.tag == "FT_5001" or r.tag == "FT_2101-1" or r.tag == "FT_5002") and r._field == "value") |> group(columns: ["area", "equipment", "tag", "variable", "unit"]) |> last() |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and (r.area == "AguaIndustrial" or r.area == "AguaAlimentacion" or r.area == "AguaDesmineralizada" or r.area == "VaporSobrecalentado" or r.area == "Condensado") and r._field == "value") |> group(columns: ["area", "equipment", "tag", "variable", "unit", "quality"]) |> last() |> group() |> keep(columns: ["area", "equipment", "tag", "variable", "unit", "quality", "_value", "_time"]) |> sort(columns: ["area", "tag"])

panels.title: Tabla operacional por TAG: área, equipo, medición, unidad y valor

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -12h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "anomaly_event") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "perdida_vapor_condensado") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "score", "message", "probable_cause", "impacted_kpis"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -12h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "maintenance_recommendation") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.equipment == "CircuitoAguaVaporCondensado") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "suggested_action", "due_minutes", "expected_impact", "ack_status"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
